create_azure_gpt_model: create an AzureGptLanguageModel instance with a model name, API key, Azure endpoint, and API version
create_azure_gpt_from_env: create an AzureGptLanguageModel that reads API credentials from AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY and AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT environment variables
sample_text_azure_gpt: sample text from an Azure GPT model by calling sample_text with a prompt string
sample_choice_azure_gpt: sample a multiple choice response from an Azure GPT model by calling sample_choice with a prompt and response options
configure_azure_gpt_measurements: configure an AzureGptLanguageModel with a measurements object to log usage statistics to a named channel
